newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ISMA links up with Deutscher Kassenverein.
newsitem.headline: ISMA links up with Deutscher Kassenverein.

text.p: The International Securities Market Association (ISMA) has linked its trade confirmation system TRAX with Deutscher Kassenverein AG's settlement system CASCADE, ISMA said at its annual general meeting on Thursday.
The development of the first phase of the link will start immediately and is expected to be fully operational in the second half of 1997, ISMA said.

ISMA is the self-regulatory industry body and trade association for the international securities market. TRAX is ISMA's real-time trade confirmation, affirmation, risk management and regulatory reporting system.
Deutsche Kassenverein, part of the Deutsche Borse Group, is the central securities depository in Germany for German securities.
